title: Fourier norm and spectral one norm
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$ and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$. The Fourier one norm of $f$ equals the spectral $1$-norm of the function on $(\mathbb F_2)^n$ obtained by composing $f$ with the coordinatewise map from bits to signs.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube of dimension $n$
